name: trackingtime
description: Official TrackingTime agents. Your back office, with the roles you need — Office Manager (clock in and out, breaks, who's in today, fill your timesheet, end-of-day report), HR Manager (hour-logging reminders, escalation, compliance reports, time off requests, approvals, holidays, who's out), Payroll Assistant (pay period hours per person, overtime, absences, period close and lock, CSV for payroll) and Account Manager (retainer burn alerts, client reports, unbilled hours, invoices, expenses).
